Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant (source column uniform_id, '<sample>_<number>', e.g. du_1). Identifiers do not overlap between the two waves.

Data collection sample (source column lang). Wave 1: du, ee, en, fi, ge, gr, he, it, ko, no, ru, sp, tr. Wave 2: ba, bp, ch_s, ch_t, da, en_uk, ge_po, ge_zu, hi_iiith, hi_iitk, ic, no, ru_mo, se, sp_ch, tr. Where a language has several samples the code names the site or script: ge_po Potsdam, ge_zu Zurich, hi_iiith Hyderabad, hi_iitk Kanpur, ru_mo Moscow, sp_ch Chile, en_uk United Kingdom, bp Brazil, ch_s / ch_t simplified / traditional Chinese script.
Participant's native or first-acquired language, which is also the language of the texts read (derived from lab).

Text read on this trial (1-12). The same 12 encyclopedic topics were used in every language: 1 Janus, 2 Shaka sign, 3 Doping, 4 Thylacine, 5 World Environment Day, 6 Monocle, 7 Wine tasting, 8 Orange juice, 9 Beekeeping, 10 National flag, 11 International Union for Conservation of Nature, 12 Vehicle registration plate. Established by matching the words of each trial to the reading materials; equals the source column trialid except on 27 trials of 6 participants (see README.md).

Position of the text in the session as recorded by the experiment's trial counter (source column trialnum; exp2 only, unchanged). The counter includes the practice text where there was one: texts sit at 2-13 in most samples and at 1-12 in ba and no. 14 Danish participants have text 12 at position 1 (see README.md). Wave 1 records no trial counter, so exp1.csv has no trial_order.
Position of the interest area within the text (1-based; source column wordnum).
Index of the sentence containing the word within the text (source column sentnum).
The interest area as displayed, with attached punctuation (source column word). Empty for 21 interest-area positions that cover the space between two sentences rather than a word.
Total reading time on the word in milliseconds (dwell time summed over all fixations; source column dur). 0 means the word was never fixated.
Duration of the first fixation on the word in milliseconds (source column firstfix.dur). Empty if the word was never fixated.

Sum of fixations during the first run through the word, in milliseconds (source column firstrun.dur). For a word skipped during first-pass reading and fixated later, this is the first later run. Empty if the word was never fixated.

Time from first entering the word until moving past it to the right, including regressions, in milliseconds (source column firstrun.gopast). Empty if the word was never fixated, if it was skipped during first-pass reading (the source stores 0 there), or if the reader did not move past it before the trial ended.
Number of fixations landing on the word (source column nfix). 0 if the word was never fixated.
Number of separate runs of fixations on the word (source column nrun). 0 if the word was never fixated.
Binary indicator of whether the word received any fixation (1) or none at all (0); the complement of the source column skip.
Binary indicator of whether the word was skipped during first-pass reading (source column firstrun.skip). A first-pass skipped word may still be fixated later during a regression.
Binary indicator of whether at least one regression entered the word during the trial (source column reg.in). Empty if the word was never fixated.
Binary indicator of whether at least one regression left the word during the trial (source column reg.out). Empty if the word was never fixated.
